jobs.description:
The Role

Our Purpose

Planday from Xero is a leading digital solution that uncomplicates everyday scheduling and workforce management by making it easier for businesses and shift workers around the world to communicate, collaborate, and get work done.

Powered by a community of local industry experts, Planday provides a best-in-class digital platform that is easy to use, accurate, secure, and compliant with local needs and standards. From payroll and accounting to POS and reporting, its open API and tech ecosystem is scalable to fit shifting business needs and to build an engaged, flexible workforce.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark and supports over 400,000 users across Europe, Australia and the US. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

How you’ll make an impact

As our Lead Engineer- Data, you will set the architectural direction of the data platform that enables both the decisions we make internally and the data-driven features our customers rely on. Working with the Data, ML, Platform, and Product Engineering teams, you will keep ingestion, modelling, and orchestration dependable, and define the modelling, testing, and documentation standards the data function depends on. You will innovate on how people work with data, building the agentic tooling and semantic modelling that let teams across Planday work from trusted data with confidence.

What you’ll do

• 
Set the architectural direction of our data platform so it serves analytics, product engineering, and AI/ML from one coherent design, collaborating with Platform and ML engineering on shared infrastructure.

• 
Design the dbt models, semantic layer, and quality standards the data function depends on, with the validation and lineage to make them trustworthy downstream.

• 
Own orchestration and observability in Dagster, and onboarding new sources in a way that scales.

• 
Innovate on self-serve and AI-enabled analytics, from semantic models and agentic workflows to our BI layer.

• 
Build the historical and low-latency foundations that make predictive and real-time use cases possible.

• 
Introduce better modelling standards, tooling, and development environments.

• 
Keep the platform reliable, performant, cost-effective, and compliant.

Success looks like

• 
Architecture that holds up as we scale and as new use cases emerge, and that other engineers follow as a pattern.

• 
Analysts ship faster and more efficiently because your tooling & standards remove friction.

• 
A drop in repeat requests to the data team, as stakeholders answer their own questions through agentic workflows.

• 
ML and product teams have the historical and real-time data they need, without bespoke workarounds.

• 
Strong working relationships with the Data, ML, and Platform teams.

What you’ll bring with you

• 
Deep, hands-on Snowflake and dbt experience: modelling, semantic layers, agents & skills, testing, performance and cost tuning.

• 
Production experience with a pipeline orchestrator, ideally Dagster (or similar Airflow, Prefect), including dependent workloads, partial failures, and observability.

• 
Modern cloud infrastructure (Azure/AWS/GCP) and Kubernetes experience deploying and operating containerised workloads, plus infrastructure as code (Terraform).

• 
Strong SQL & Python for pipelines, services, and automation.

• 
Software engineering discipline across CI/CD, testing, and code review.

• 
The ability to turn technical trade-offs into clear narratives that help stakeholders decide and trust the work.

• 
Experience operating data systems, including incident response, cost, and data privacy practices.

At Planday, we offer you

• 
Benefits like pension, health insurance, inclusive support for new parents and generous vacation

• 
On top of your annual base salary, you are offered to be part of an Employee Share Plan

• 
Growth and progression opportunities – we want you to grow with us

• 
Flexible remote work

• 
Strong social culture with lots of team and company activities

• 
Meaningful work – everyone at Planday contributes to improving the lives of shift workers around the globe

• 
Healthy work-life balance and autonomous approach to work. We trust in you and your abilities

Finally, our offices are not just workplaces (although they are pretty nice and well-located, we have to say!). Plandayers are open and welcoming and at Planday, everyone has the freedom and support to show their true self at work.

At Planday, we firmly believe that diversity and inclusion are the cornerstones of innovation and a vibrant workplace culture. As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to create an equitable experience for all candidates throughout the process. Please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments during the application or interview process.

Customer Success Manager UK

• 
On-site

• 

• Copenhagen, Hovedstaden, Denmark

• 
Customer Experience

Job description

Are you a Relationship Builder and a Problem Solver who thrives on helping small businesses succeed? Do you get a buzz from turning happy customers into long-term partners? Famly is looking for a proactive, data-driven Customer Success Manager to nurture and grow our existing Small-to-Medium Business (SMB) customers across the UK and Nordics.

What you’ll be doing 🛠️

As a trusted advisor , your mission is to ensure our SMB customers - from single sites to growing small groups - are maximising the value they get from Famly.

• 
Own the Relationship: Serve as the primary point of contact for your portfolio of accounts, building meaningful, trust-based relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders.

• 
Drive Retention & Growth: Proactively manage churn risk by analysing client usage patterns, conducting regular, data-led check-ins, and facilitating account reviews to ensure customers are achieving their desired outcomes.

• 
Be a Product Expert: Educate clients on Famly’s features and tools, acting on feedback to suggest proactive solutions that meet their goals and lead to maximum value and adoption.

• 
Expand our Footprint: Identify opportunities to upsell and cross-sell relevant features and services , partnering with our Sales team to contribute to Net New ARR growth.

• 
Act as an Internal Advocate: Gather customer insights and serve as the voice of the customer internally, tracking feedback to drive continuous improvement in our products and service delivery.

• 
Collaborate Seamlessly: Work closely with our Onboarding, Sales, Advisory, and Product teams to ensure a smooth, end-to-end customer experience , particularly through the crucial first year of using Famly.

Job requirements

What excites you 🌟

A role where you can have a direct, measurable impact on the business and a long-term influence on customer outcomes:

Impact on the Bottom Line: You'll directly contribute to our overall ARR growth, retention rates, and upsell revenue targets - your success is our success.

Data as Your Guide: You'll use strong analytical skills and data proficiency to maintain accurate account records in our CRM , identifying where to maximise your time for the greatest portfolio impact.AI as Your Teammate: You'll embrace AI tools like Claude as a core part of your daily workflow and join weekly AI Lab sessions where as a team, we can learn and experiment together.

Challenge & Growth: You'll thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment , bringing your positive attitude and adaptable nature to inspire confidence in your clients and teammates.

Genuine Empathy: You'll excel because you genuinely care about understanding and solving client challenges , using a proactive and resourceful mindset to anticipate needs and find creative solutions.

What excites us 🔥

Someone who is ready to build lasting partnerships and drive success 🤝

• 
Exceptional Communicator: You have proven, exceptional communication and interpersonal skills , allowing you to engage effectively with all stakeholders.

• 
Collaborative Team Player: You know that the team is crucial for personal success. You always go above and beyond to support your teammates and are experienced working across different departments.

• 
Data and CRM Savvy: You have strong analytical skills and proficiency with CRM and data analysis tools to assess account performance and spot growth opportunities.

• 
Results-Driven Focus: You have a track record of being results-oriented , thriving on achieving goals and driving both client and business success.

• 
Proactive Prioritiser: You have the ability to prioritise and manage multiple accounts effectively, ensuring you mitigate churn while driving growth

👯 You’ll be working with

A team of friendly, boisterous CSMs and Onboarding Specialists who are dedicated to their customers, who pick each other up on tough days and never stop pushing the limits. We come from all over the world, but what connects us is our passion for what we do - and the joy of doing it together. Expect high energy, tons of support, a few (OK, many) Slack GIFs, and an obsession with both hitting goals and having a good time.

💚 About Famly

At Famly, we're on a mission to give children the best possible start to life by supporting the people who make that happen every day: early-years professionals.

It all started when our co-founder Henrik dropped off his daughter at daycare and realised how much was still being done with pen and paper—and how distant that made him feel from her day. Together with Anders, now our CEO, they set out to build software that bridges that gap.

Today, Famly is used by 34,000+ childcare professionals and hundreds of thousands of parents to:

• 
Communicate in real-time

• 
Reduce admin stress

• 
Improve planning, pedagogy, and finances

• 
And ultimately, give more time to the little ones that matter most

Want to help us do even more of that? We’d love to have you.

🚀 Why you’ll love working at Famly

• 
You’ll be surrounded by clever, kind people who support each other

• 
We give you ownership, the freedom to try new things, all backed by trust

• 
Top-tier equipment (noise-cancelling headphones included)

• 
Onsite learning from peers, leaders and coaches as well as regular team and company activities

• 
Ongoing personal and professional development beyond sales skills

• 
A mission you can believe in, and see the impact of daily

In the Copenhagen HQ, we also have:

• 
Daily buffet, a well-stocked drinks fridge, and “the most office snacks in Copenhagen, probably!”

• 
Plenty of social activities... board game nights, go climbing with colleagues, themed Friday bars, big quarterly social events, team fun with dinners out, office BBQs, and more!

📋 The interview process

Here’s what to expect:

• 
Intro call with Neeta, from the People & Talent team

• 
Rational thinking test (We use the GIA by Thomas.co)

• 
Interview with Naomi, Head of Customer Success, UK

• 
Case study presentation and interview with Naomi and another team member

• 
Final interview with Matt, UK General Manager

• 
Reference check

We move fast and keep it human throughout.

📬 Ready to apply?

We’re hiring right now, so don’t wait around.

👉 Send us:

• 
Your CV, and

• 
Tell us what excites you about Famly and why you’d be a great fit, by putting pen to paper or recording a short video 🎥

Famly is committed to creating a more diverse, equal, and inclusive workforce, building teams that represent a variety of backgrounds, perspectives and experiences. It is a fundamental policy at Famly not to discriminate on any basis or characteristics and celebrate diversity. Everyone is welcome and encouraged to apply.

Job description

Are you ready to kick‑start your career in finance? Trackman’s Commercial Finance Team is looking for a motivated and detail‑oriented Commercial Finance Accountant who wants to grow in a global, tech‑driven company transforming the world of sports.

In this role, you’ll support our accounts receivable and billing processes, help ensure smooth customer interactions, and contribute to the financial backbone of our business. If you’re eager to learn, excited about working with international stakeholders, and passionate about building a strong foundation in finance, we’d love to meet you.

Job Description

As a Commercial Finance Accountant, you’ll play an important role in supporting our day‑to‑day financial operations across multiple markets and sports. You’ll work closely with colleagues in sales, customer service, and finance to ensure accurate invoicing, timely payment processing, and great customer experience.

This position is ideal for someone early in their career who wants to develop strong financial skills and gain exposure to a fast‑growing global organization.

Your Responsibilities Include:

• 
Assisting with invoicing and accounts receivable tasks

• 
Monitoring outstanding payments and supporting follow‑up activities

• 
Reconciling customer accounts and helping resolve discrepancies

• 
Supporting internal teams with billing‑related questions

• 
Preparing basic financial reports and documentation

• 
Helping improve and streamline administrative and finance processes

• 
Contributing to system updates, automation initiatives, and ad‑hoc tasks

Job requirements

• 
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or equivalent. Recent Master’s graduates in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration are also welcome

• 
Strong attention to detail and a structured working style

• 
Good communication skills and a collaborative mindset

• 
Comfortable working with numbers and learning new systems

• 
Fluent in English, both written and spoken

Bonus Points If You Have

• 
Experience from a finance function (e.g., invoicing, payment processing, customer support, or similar student/part‑time roles)

• 
Familiarity with Microsoft Dynamics or another ERP system

• 
Experience working in an international or tech‑driven environment

• 
A proactive approach and willingness to take ownership as you grow

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!

Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your application as soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: Junior Assistant in Global Sales Excellence, Commercial Development
jobs.description:
Looking for gaining business knowledge and experience during your gap year?

Are you an ambitious, talented, and driven student, who has just finished high school and is looking to gain knowledge and experience from a large corporation with an interest in business. Are you looking for a job which is truly meaningful, where you play an important part in making life easier for people living with intimate healthcare conditions all around the world? Then this Junior Assistant position in Coloplast Global Sales Excellence team might be right for you.

Make a difference globally

At our headquarters in Humlebæk, you will join our highly ambitious Sales Excellence team, which is responsible for developing and building the capabilities of our sales teams across the world who are the frontline for driving more access to our innovative products and services.

“You will be part of a strong, diverse and passionate team that is extremely driven to drive business impact through equipping our sales teams with state of the art training and enablement programs that in turn will drive greater access to the users of our market leading products and services around the world. We have a true collaborative spirit and customer first mentality, but it’s also important for us to have fun on the way. Together, we are making a real difference to our sales teams, our business but most importantly the healthcare professionals and users of our products and services.” explains Nick Elliot, Head of Sales Excellence, Commercial Development.

About the job

You will be supporting your colleagues in the Sales Excellence team with various assignments, while having your own areas of responsibility. You will find that we are always ready to support each other and share best practices and general knowledge along the way.

More specifically, you will:

• Support the implementation and management of our Learning Management System, Mindtickle

• Coordinate meetings and events for the teams

• Be a contact to our sales subsidiaries worldwide and external partners

• Take care of shipments and communication to subsidiaries and other partners

• Support the wider commercial development team

You can act independently but also love to collaborate with people!

You are Independent, responsible, organized, and collaborative team player. You are thorough and understand the importance of working to a high-quality standard.  You have a positive can-do attitude and feel comfortable interacting with many different colleagues across borders and nationalities.

To be successful in this role you should have the following qualifications:

• You have graduated high school

• Familiar with Microsoft office

• Fluency in English – Danish skills are not required

Interested?

If you would like to know more about the position, please reach out to Head of Sales Excellence, Nick Elliot on gbnel@coloplast.com. We will take candidates into the recruitment process continuously, so do not hesitate to apply. This position will remain open until a suitable candidate has been found.

Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.

Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religious belief or physical ability.

Visit us on Coloplast.com.

Watch the film. Follow us on LinkedIn.

As After Sales Team Lead you are responsible for leading the After Sales team to ensure efficient handling of Warranty claims, Service and Spare Parts, driving continuous improvements in After Sales processes, and delivering excellent service to customers and internal stakeholders. You will manage After Sales lifecycle activities from claim intake and technical assessment to reimbursement and root‑cause analysis, ensuring compliance with company policy and regulatory requirements as well as overseeing Service and Spare Parts requests and fulfilment processes.

The Team Lead is responsible for defining and implementing After Sales processes, KPI structures and continuous improvement initiatives across the business.

As Team Lead, you will have both leadership and operational responsibilities. In addition to leading and supporting the team, you will actively handle cases and contribute to the day-to-day operations.

Your Impact

• 
Lead and coach a team of 2 After Sales specialists, providing day‑to‑day guidance, performance management and development opportunities.

• 
Own the end‑to‑end After Sales process including claim registration, technical evaluation, cost assessment, Service and Spare Parts request, approval of workflows and supplier recovery.

• 
Coordinate cross‑functional collaboration with Technical Sales Support, Sales Support, Order Handling, Product Management, R&D, Operations and Procurement to investigate failures, agree corrective actions and secure parts or financial recovery where appropriate.

• 
Drive root‑cause analysis and structured corrective actions (8D, RCA) to reduce warranty costs and recurrence of issues.

• 
Drive process optimization by developing and implementing efficient case handling procedures that reduce lead times and improve the customer and stakeholder experience.

• 
Ensure timely and accurate warranty reporting and maintenance of warranty and Service records, KPIs and dashboards to inform management decisions.

• 
Manage supplier and partner interactions for warranty claims, including negotiation of liability, credit notes and technical clarifications.

• 
Improve processes and documentation to increase efficiency, reduce cycle time and strengthen compliance with internal policies and external regulations.

• 
Ensure a customer-centric approach to all after-sales activities, balancing commercial interests with long-term customer satisfaction and loyalty.

What Drives Success

• 
Strong Proven experience in warranty management, after‑sales operations or service management, preferably within industrial equipment, HVAC or related sectors.

• 
Strong Technical understanding of mechanical and electrical systems and the ability to interpret technical reports, test data and service feedback.

• 
Leadership skills with experience in coaching teams, prioritizing workload and driving continuous improvement in a customer‑facing environment.

• 
Structured and analytical approach with strong problem‑solving skills, attention to detail and experience using data to drive decisions.

• 
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills; comfortable negotiating with suppliers and collaborating across functions.

• 
Experience with systems such as CRM, ERP (IFS ) or warranty management tools and proficiency in creating reports and maintaining accurate records.

• 
Commercial awareness and the ability to balance customer satisfaction with cost control and compliance.

• 
Language. Fluent in Danish and English, German language skills are an advantage but not essential

What We Offer

• 
A central, visible role in an international company with direct impact on customer satisfaction and product performance.

• 
The opportunity to shape after sales processes and influence cross-functional improvements.

• 
Competitive salary and employee benefits in line with company policy.

• 
25 days’ annual leave plus 5 days Feriefri after the qualifying period.

• 
Standard auto-enrolment pension scheme and access to a healthcare scheme.

• 
Professional development and training through NOVENCollege, with clear progression paths.

• 
An inclusive workplace that values diversity and equal opportunity.

Context

This is an onsite role at our HQ in Næstved. The After Sales Team Lead reports to the Head of Sales Support & Service and will work closely with Technical Sales Support, Sales Support, Product Management, R&D, Operations and Procurement.

How to apply

Please submit your CV via our careers page. Applications are reviewed on receipt and interviews are scheduled on a rolling basis.

NOVENCO Building & Industry is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all backgrounds.

About NOVENCO® Building & Industry A/S

Engineering a Greener and Safer World

At NOVENCO, we create ventilation solutions that deliver high energy efficiency with minimal environmental impact. Our mission is clear: provide sustainable systems with low life-cycle costs that meet – and consistently exceed – customer expectations.

Reliability for Life Safety

Our life-safety ventilation solutions are engineered for absolute reliability. Designed to meet the highest international standards, they support critical applications across numerous industries, where dependable performance is essential to safeguarding people, property and operations.

Innovation Since 1947

With more than seven decades of engineering expertise, we continue to refine our products and production processes. Our automated, high-tech manufacturing, supported by advanced robotics, ensures minimal waste and maximum recyclability. This results in a product portfolio recognised for long service life, exceptional durability and proven sustainability.

jobs.occupation: Global Business Services (GBS) Finance Transformation Manager
jobs.description:
Global Business Services (GBS) Finance Transformation Manager

• Full-time

• Field of interest: Technology, Transformation & Data

• Level of hire: Experienced hire

Company Description

With more than 2,700 employees, Deloitte is the largest audit and consultancy firm in Denmark. We tailor solutions across Audit, Tax, Financial Advisory Services, Enterprise Risk Services, Technology, and Transformations.

About our team

Finance Transformation is part of Deloitte’s consulting practice and consists of 350 dedicated consultants who work within all aspects of the CFO area and engage with clients to advise, transform, optimise, and operate the finance function. We have private and public as well as national and international clients across different industries and of different sizes, and we work with the lion’s share of C25 companies and public institutions.

Global Business Services (GBS) is an integral part of Deloitte’s Finance Transformation practice. The GBS team is dedicated to helping organizations transform their business operations, driving higher efficiency, effectiveness, and agility. By leveraging a comprehensive suite of services, the GBS practice supports clients in optimizing shared services, outsourcing, and global business service models to create value and enhance performance.

We are seeking an experienced and skilled Transformation Manager to join our GBS team. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of operating model structures and Business Process Re-engineering driven through the lens of cost optimization and efficiency augmentation, experience with the interplay of technology and process design, and change management capabilities. This role will be pivotal in driving strategic business transformation initiatives, focusing on re-enforcing cost optimization strategies by energizing core operational processes and technology design and implementation phases (ERP, process mining, automation and visualization tools).

Job Description

As a Transformation Manager, you will lead large complex engagements for some of the world's biggest organizations. You will identify, design, and implement creative business and technology solutions aimed at driving operational effectiveness, cost efficiencies and organizational agility. In this role, you will architect strategies and transformation programs that will enable process excellence and value creation by optimizing day-to-day operational finance functions using lean methodology in end-to-end process areas such as order to cash, procure to pay, close, consolidation, reporting. You will be responsible for leading business model transformations and cultivating enterprise agility to ensure transformations are anchored in, and unlock, value.

In this role, you will make an impact by:

• Leading Project Delivery

• Driving large scale transformations, complex and cross functional engagements

• Advising clients on process re-engineering and process optimization to support enterprise-wide decision-making, improve finance operations, and strengthen stakeholder management

• Lead the technology solution design and implementation ensuring high quality adhering to the timelines and defined budget

• Engaging in Executive- Level Interactions

• Partner with C-level executives to address strategic objectives and challenges.

• Present actionable strategies in clear, compelling terms.

• Driving Business Development

• Lead RFPs/ proposal preparation by collaborating across competencies/ alliances/ service lines.

• Cultivate and nurture client relationships beyond project delivery, exploring avenues for repeat business.

• Stakeholder Management

• Build and maintain strong connections with CXOs across various sectors.

• Project Financials

• Manage budgets and financial performance for your projects.

• Mentorship and Team Culture-

• Mentor and guide a team of consultants, fostering a positive and collaborative culture.

• Encourage professional growth and knowledge sharing.

Qualifications

Ideally, you have:

• Around 6-9 years of relevant experience in finance transformation, finance process excellence, GBS, Shared Services and/or BPO sector

• 4+ years of Direct people management experience

• Bachelor's degree from an accredited university

• Fluency in Danish is a big plus

What you bring to the team:

• Experience with process excellence, including but not limited to end-to-end process areas such as order to cash, procure to pay, close, consolidation, reporting

• Knowledge of GBS lifecycle and able to run projects in it as a Project Manager

• Experience with enabling technologies in core finance processes (e.g., Basware, HighRadius, BlackLine, etc.)

• Experience in using tools for process mining, visualization tools, Robotics Process Automation (RPA) and understanding of GenAI opportunities in driving transformation

• Strong process expertise in transforming and optimizing day-to-day operational functions (e.g. finance, HR) using lean methodology

• Experience in designing leading practice-based processes and driving the entire journey from assessment, design to implementation

• Superior critical thinking, analytical and problem-solving skills

• Exceptional interpersonal, team-building and oral and written communication skills; outstanding integrity, initiative, creativity, and passion

• Experience with ServiceNow, Salesforce or other customer-oriented workflow platforms

• Baseline understanding and position on the current and future applications of Artificial Intelligence in GBS

Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we still encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can make an impact on our team.

Additional Information

Do you want to be part of our team?

Click the "I am interested" button above if you are ready to join our team.

Send your CV by 30.11.2026. We process applications and arrange interviews continually, so we recommend that you apply as soon as possible.

Expected start date: Flexible

Please do not hesitate to contact Nadiia Novikova at nshamarina@deloitte.dk if you have any questions about the position.

At Deloitte, we value different skills, perspectives, and experiences, as it enables us to effectively solve complex challenges for our clients. We encourage you to apply for the position if you believe your skills can contribute to our team´s success.

We encourage all candidates to apply for the position regardless of, e.g., age, gender (gender identity and gender expression), sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, nationality, or disability.

By applying for this job, you will be assessed against the Deloitte Global Talent Standards. We have designed these standards to provide a consistent and exceptional Deloitte employee experience globally.

We look forward to connecting with you!

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.

Team Lead, Software Development - Trading & Monitoring

Do you have experience leading developers – and are you more motivated by making a team succeed than by writing the code yourself? Then you may be our new Team Lead for Trading & Monitoring.

Who we are

Eurowind Energy is a global and leading developer, owner and operator of energy parks. Based in Denmark, we operate in 16 countries around Europe and in the USA, and we are continuously growing our project portfolio. We believe in a future of renewable energy, and we have an ambitious plan of becoming the next generation’s “Power Major”. Based on a full value chain from greenfield project development to energy trading, more than 700 team members are dedicated to creating a greener future fueled with nothing but renewable energy!

We are looking for an experienced Team Lead to join our Trading & Monitoring team in IT Software. Based at our headquarters in Hobro, you will have people responsibility for five developers who build and operate the platforms behind Eurowind’s energy trading and the monitoring of our parks.

Your role

This position is deliberately shaped differently from our two other team lead roles. Where they are “playing coaches” with their weight on the technical side, this one is dedicated to people and to the framework the team works within. You do not need to write code to succeed here – you need to build a team that does.

• People leadership of five developers: regular 1:1s, feedback, development plans and career paths

• Allocating tasks and areas of responsibility within the team, matching both the team’s deliverables and each individual’s skills and development goals

• Ownership of team culture, wellbeing and day-to-day ways of working

• Conflict handling within the team – you mediate between team members rather than only holding the conversations 1:1

• Recruitment and onboarding of new colleagues, together with HR and your manager

• Approving holiday and absence, and proposing salary changes within HR’s framework

• Identifying and removing blockers and delivery risks – yourself, or by escalating

• Acting as the link between the team and the wider organisation, including Trading and Commercial

• Sparring with the Product Owner, Scrum Master and architect on planning, estimation and prioritisation

You work closely with the team’s Product Owner and Scrum Master, who own what gets built and how we work respectively. Technical ownership is shared with the team’s senior developers and our architect – so you can stay focused where you make the biggest difference.

You own the how

We lead through direction and frameworks rather than close supervision. We agree the mandate and the expectations, and from there you decide the route.

• Significant autonomy in execution and real influence over how your team works

• A department with written, clarified roles (Manager, Product Owner, Scrum Master, architect and Team Lead)

• Two experienced team lead colleagues to spar with, and a steady leadership rhythm of syncs and 1:1s

• Flexible working hours and the option to work from home

• Lunch scheme, coffee, tea and fruit, discount agreements and a bonus scheme

• An international environment with colleagues in 16 countries, where English is a natural part of everyday work

You will report to Senior Manager of Software Development, Daniel Otkjær, and become part of the leadership group in IT Software.

Who tends to thrive in this role

What matters most to us is demonstrated experience leading people. We are looking for someone who:

• Has several years of people management experience, ideally with developers or other specialists

• Has experience with 1:1s, feedback and development conversations – and with mediating when conflicts arise between colleagues

• Has been involved in recruitment and onboarding

• Understands agile software development and how a development team delivers

• Communicates clearly and creates direction and psychological safety in a team

• Is comfortable making decisions and standing by them

• Is fluent in Danish and English, written and spoken

A technical background – for example as a developer, tech lead or architect – is a clear plus, but not a requirement. Familiarity with energy trading or the energy sector is likewise an advantage, but something you can readily learn with us.

jobs.occupation: Research Associate – Peptide Chemistry Discovery Platform
jobs.description:
Research Associate – Peptide Chemistry Discovery Platform

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark

Employment type: Full-time

Are you passionate about practical chemistry?

Are you an early-career chemist or laboratory technician with strong hands-on laboratory skills? Would you like to develop your expertise in peptide chemistry, automation and modern analytical techniques while contributing directly to innovative drug-discovery programmes?

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Research Associate to join a Platform Chemistry team in Copenhagen.

This is a laboratory-based position for someone who enjoys experimental work, operating advanced equipment and producing reliable, high-quality results. You will work with automated synthesis workflows, generate linear and macrocyclic peptide libraries, and use modern purification and analytical technologies to support the discovery of potential future medicines.

Direct experience with peptide chemistry is an advantage, but it is not essential. Candidates with a strong practical chemistry background and a genuine interest in learning peptide chemistry are encouraged to apply.

About the organisation

You will join an innovative and growing biotechnology organisation developing a new generation of orally available macrocycle therapeutics.

The organisation combines artificial intelligence, automated chemistry, high-throughput experimentation and real-compound data to design molecules capable of addressing challenging biological targets. Its ambition is to develop oral alternatives to medicines that are traditionally administered by injection, particularly within inflammation and immune-driven diseases.

The Copenhagen research site includes a modern laboratory environment and an experienced multidisciplinary team of chemists, scientists and technology specialists.

About the role

As a Research Associate in Platform Chemistry, you will help deliver the experimental chemistry that drives the organisation’s drug-discovery platform.

You will work alongside experienced peptide chemists and scientists to execute automated synthesis workflows, produce compound libraries and evaluate experimental results. You will also operate, optimise and troubleshoot laboratory equipment such as peptide synthesisers, liquid-handling systems and LC-MS instruments.

The role offers an excellent opportunity to build specialised knowledge in peptide and macrocycle chemistry. You will receive training in automated synthesis, purification, analysis and platform operation while contributing directly to active discovery programmes.

This position is particularly well suited to someone who enjoys spending time in the laboratory, takes pride in accurate experimental work and is motivated by learning new techniques and technologies.

Your responsibilities

As part of the Platform Chemistry team, you will:

• Execute automated workflows for the synthesis of linear and macrocyclic peptide libraries.

• Operate peptide synthesisers, liquid-handling systems, purification equipment and LC-MS instruments.

• Prepare reagents, samples and laboratory materials for experimental workflows.

• Monitor experimental performance and identify deviations or technical issues.

• Optimise and troubleshoot automated laboratory methods and instrumentation.

• Purify and analyse compounds using modern chromatographic and analytical techniques.

• Interpret experimental and analytical data accurately.

• Document methods, observations, results and deviations in a clear and structured way.

• Communicate findings to colleagues across Platform Chemistry and drug-discovery teams.

• Support the delivery of high-quality compounds for research programmes.

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of laboratory workflows.

• Help maintain reliable and efficient day-to-day platform operations.

• Work according to relevant laboratory, quality and safety procedures.

Your background

You may hold one of the following qualifications:

• A bachelor’s or master’s degree in chemistry, chemical engineering or a related scientific field.

• A laboratory technician or laboratory technologist qualification.

• Another relevant scientific qualification combined with strong practical laboratory experience.

Your skills and experience

We are looking for someone who has:

• Strong practical laboratory skills.

• Experience with common synthetic chemistry, purification or analytical techniques.

• Experience operating laboratory equipment and instrumentation.

• Familiarity with equipment such as automated synthesisers, liquid handlers, HPLC, UPLC or LC-MS systems.

• A structured and careful approach to experimental work.

• A strong understanding of the importance of reproducibility and data quality.

• The ability to follow established methods while recognising opportunities for improvement.

• Confidence working independently with laboratory procedures after appropriate training.

• Good written and verbal communication skills.

• The ability to collaborate effectively in a multidisciplinary scientific team.

Experience with peptide chemistry, solid-phase peptide synthesis or macrocycle chemistry is desirable, but not required.

Your personal qualities

You are likely to succeed in this role if you:

• Genuinely enjoy practical laboratory work.

• Are curious and motivated to learn new chemistry, instrumentation and software.

• Take ownership of the quality of your experimental results.

• Pay close attention to detail.

• Approach technical problems in a structured and patient way.

• Are comfortable working with both routine workflows and experimental optimisation.

• Communicate unexpected results or technical issues openly.

• Enjoy working in a collaborative and fast-developing environment.

• Are adaptable and comfortable learning new technologies.

• Want your laboratory work to contribute directly to meaningful scientific progress.

What you can expect

This opportunity offers:

• A hands-on role in an innovative biotechnology environment.

• Training in peptide synthesis, macrocycle chemistry, purification and analysis.

• Experience with advanced automation and high-throughput laboratory technologies.

• The opportunity to become an expert user of a sophisticated discovery platform.

• Direct involvement in active drug-discovery programmes.

• Close collaboration with experienced scientists and peptide chemists.

• A modern laboratory environment in Copenhagen.

• Significant opportunities for technical and professional development.

• The chance to contribute to technologies designed to improve how future medicines are developed and delivered.

Why this role matters

The molecules designed by a drug-discovery platform only become valuable when they can be produced, analysed and tested reliably.

Your work will help transform digital molecular designs into real compounds. By delivering accurate, reproducible experimental chemistry, you will provide scientists with the materials and data they need to identify promising therapeutic candidates.

In this role, your contribution will be practical, visible and directly connected to the wider discovery pipeline.

Application

Please submit your application or contact Black Swans Exist to express your interest or learn more about the position and recruitment process.

Applications will be reviewed continuously.

Black Swans Exist

jobs.occupation: Team Lead & Field Service Engineer, EMEA
jobs.description:
Introduction

We are looking for an ambitious and talented Team Lead & Field Service Engineer based in Ballerup, Denmark. The ideal candidate has a minimum of 10 years of experience in servicing and maintaining scientific, analytical, biomedical, or laboratory equipment.

About the Role

The Team Lead for the 1st Level Service and Support Team plays a critical role in leading and developing the regional Field Service Engineering and Technical Support function across Europe. The role combines people leadership, hands-on technical support, and customer-facing field activities, working closely with the team to ensure a high level of customer satisfaction and operational excellence.

With a strong focus on customer experience, the Team Lead works in close collaboration with the Application Science Manager for the region and Regional Account Managers to ensure seamless service delivery, proactive customer engagement, and successful resolution of technical challenges.

In this position, you should expect approximately 50% travel. Travel within Europe will typically involve up to two overnight stays per trip, while overseas travel may involve longer stays. We expect 80 to 100 overnight travel days per year.

About Us

Sophion Bioscience is a leading global life science company founded in 2000 by a group of passionate electrophysiologists with the aim of making patch clamping objective and independent of user skill.

We specialize in developing and manufacturing automated patch clamp and cell line solutions. Through our comprehensive technical, biological, and application support, we help our partners advance ion channel research and drug discovery. We take the voodoo out of patch clamping, enabling faster, more accurate, and objective results for our users.

Through the continued development of our QPatch, Qube 384 and Ethica M platforms, we offer uncompromised data quality in a user-friendly environment, from assay setup to advanced data analysis.

We are headquartered in Denmark and have subsidiaries in the United States, Japan, and China.

What You'll Do

Team Leadership

• Supervision: Oversee the daily operations of the 1st Level Service Team, ensuring efficient workflows and adherence to service standards.

• Motivation: Foster a positive team environment, encouraging collaboration and professional development among team members.

• Performance Management: Conduct regular performance evaluations, provide constructive feedback, and set goals for team members.

Technical Expertise

• On-Site Service: Actively participate in on-site installations, service visits, and breakdown support activities, demonstrating technical expertise and leadership.

• Remote Support: Actively participate in remote support sessions with customers related to installations, system maintenance, and breakdown support.

Customer Interaction

• Customer Relations: Act as the primary point of contact for key customers, addressing concerns and building strong relationships.

• Feedback Collection: Gather customer feedback during service visits to identify areas for improvement and enhance customer satisfaction.

Coordination and Communication

• Escalation Management: Act as a liaison between the 1st Level Team and 2nd Level Support, ensuring effective communication and timely escalation of unresolved issues.

• Best Practices: Identify and implement best practices to improve service delivery and operational efficiency across the team.

Who You Are

You are an experienced service professional with a passion for customer success, technical excellence, and team leadership. You thrive in a hands-on environment where no two days are the same and enjoy balancing strategic leadership responsibilities with direct customer engagement.

We imagine that you:

• Have a minimum of 10 years of experience servicing and maintaining scientific, analytical, biomedical, or laboratory equipment.

• Have previous experience leading, mentoring, or coordinating technical service teams.

• Possess strong troubleshooting and diagnostic skills across hardware, software, and integrated instrument systems.

• Are highly customer-focused and motivated by delivering exceptional service experiences.

• Communicate effectively with customers, colleagues, and stakeholders at all levels of an organization.

• Have the ability to remain calm and solution-oriented in high-pressure situations.

• Enjoy working independently while also collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.

• Are organized, proactive, and capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously.

• Are willing and able to travel extensively throughout Europe and occasionally overseas (approximately 80 to 100 overnight travel days per year).

• Are fluent in English; additional European languages are considered an advantage.

How to Apply

Please apply via LinkedIn.

If you have questions about the role, you are welcome to contact the hiring manager, the General Manager & Commercial Director, EMEA & RoW.

Questions

Please submit your questions through the LinkedIn application process (or to your internal recruiting contact, if applicable).

Start Date

As soon as possible.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and close the recruitment process once we have found the right candidate. If this opportunity excites you, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Can you find the stories worth telling and shape how an industrial sensor manufacturer communicates?

SulfiLogger is an international niche company that develops and sells high-tech chemical sensors to industrial customers around the world. Our sensors are used in industries including wastewater, biogas, oil & gas, and aquaculture where they help our customers monitor and optimize critical processes.

We operate in a technically complex B2B environment where the value of our solutions is best illustrated through customer stories. We know there are many great stories about how our sensors create value for our customers, but we simply don't have the capacity to tell them all. That's where you come in.

About the position

The Communication Specialist role is newly created, making you the first additional member of our marketing team, where you will report to our Marketing Manager.

You will own our communications function, and we expect you to independently drive it forward with sparring and support from our Marketing Manager. You should be comfortable working in a position, where there won't be a to-do list with 12 clearly defined tasks waiting for you when you arrive in the morning. You need to identify what needs to be done, take initiative, and drive projects from idea to execution independently and without relying on agencies.

Your main responsibility will be to tell the stories of how our products create value for our customers. At the same time, you will help shape the direction of our communications and ensure consistent messaging across everything we do - from ongoing communication on LinkedIn and in newsletters to the content customers face on our website, in PowerPoint presentations, in dialogues with our distributors, and in the printed materials they receive at trade shows.

The content will primarily be text-based, including case studies, customer success stories, blog posts, LinkedIn posts, and articles for industry publications. But we also want to make greater use of video-based content.

The ideal candidate

The ideal candidate has a background in communications, corporate communications, marketing, or a similar field, and at least two years of experience with B2B communications, either in-house or from an agency.

It is not important that you know anything about industrial sensors, biogas, or wastewater. What is important is that you:

• are curious, proactive, and persistent when it comes to finding the stories worth telling

• can understand technical and complex topics, identify the value our solutions provide, and communicate it in a relevant and engaging way

• can think strategically - but also get things done

• write fluent and professional English

Any additional skills is a plus. This could, for example, be within video, design and layout, web, AI, SEO/GEO, or similar areas.

What we offer

At SulfiLogger, you will join an international growth company where there is plenty of opportunities for executing on new ideas fast. You will have a high degree of independence and responsibility in your daily work, the opportunity to set the direction of our communications, and significant influence on shaping the role itself.

We are based near Egå Engsø in Risskov, with easy access by bus and letbane. You will be part of a team of more than 40 colleagues here, and we also have a division in Houston that you will support as part of your role. You can expect a good and inclusive working environment, free breakfast and lunch daily, and a high degree of flexibility in your daily work.

Practical information

• Working hours: 37 hours/week (or the possibility of part-time if preferred)

• Location: Risskov (limited opportunity for working from home)

• Salary: Based on qualifications

• Start date: As soon as possible

• We invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply quickly

• For more information: Contact Marketing Manager Peter Madsen at pem@sulfilogger.com

jobs.occupation: Software Manager – Life Science Instrument Software | Copenhagen/Ballerup, Denmark
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Software Manager to lead a team of software engineers building software for automated life science instruments. This role is for a leader with clarity, drive and curiosity — someone who can help people grow, make delivery more predictable, and shape how we use AI in everyday development. You may already be an experienced manager, or ready for your next leadership step; what matters most is your ability to create direction, build trust, and turn ambition into progress.

About the role

You lead a team of eight software engineers (frontend, backend and DevOps), report to the VP of R&D, and join the R&D management team. You own the software roadmap together with Product Management and hold budget responsibility for the function. The role is based in Ballerup, in the Copenhagen area.

Day to day you work closely with Product Management, System Engineering, Hardware, Bioscience, Quality and Technical Support. A lot of the work happens in the room rather than in documents: quick alignment at a desk, a shared look at test data, and a decision taken the same afternoon. That closeness is what makes our pace possible, and protecting the energy and team spirit that comes with it is part of your job.

What matters most to us

• Execution and structure. You know software development best practice and can turn priorities into a clear and structured plan the team understands and believes in.

• Leadership. You lead eight engineers with care and structure - performance conversations, motivation, team building - and you enjoy helping people grow.

• AI ambition. You want to change how a software team works with AI. Hands-on experience is welcome; genuine ambition and curiosity matter just as much.

What you'll do

You lead the software work from roadmap to release and set the tone for how the team collaborates:

• Own the software roadmap and release planning together with Product Management, balancing scientific priorities and business goals.

• Set the technical direction and the quality standards that keep our software robust and maintainable.

• Keep delivery predictable with clear scope, realistic timelines and visible progress.

• Lead the team day to day - hiring, onboarding, mentoring, feedback and career development.

• Shape how we use AI in software development, and share what works with the rest of the company.

• Manage the software budget and resources.

Your background

You do not need to match every point below, but we would like to hear from you if you bring a strong software foundation, leadership drive and the ambition to keep learning:

• Software engineering, computer science or similar background — either through education or equivalent practical experience.

• Solid software development experience - ideally with instruments, hardware-related or other complex product software.

• Experience guiding and mentoring engineers — formally or informally — and a strong ambition to grow into a broader leadership role over time.

• Curiosity about AI and modern ways of working, with the ambition to help the team improve how software is built and deployed.

• Fluent English.

About us

Since 2000 Sophion Bioscience has pioneered Automated Patch Clamping for ion channel research. Today, we specialize in automated solutions for pre-clinical life sciences.

We work closely with academic institutions, contract research organizations, and leading biotech and pharmaceutical companies to create effective assays for screening and characterization. Our solutions empower the study of drug targets and candidates at the bench, reducing development time in discovery and reducing risk in clinical trials.

Through the continued development of our Automated Patch Clamp portfolio (QPatch & Qube) and our new Organ On a Chip platform (Ethica), we offer uncompromised data quality in a user-friendly environment, from assay setup to advanced data analysis. We are headquartered in Denmark and have subsidiaries in the United States, Japan and China.

What we offer

• Real ownership, short decision paths, and visible impact across the company.

• A collaborative, international R&D environment with flexibility in how and when you work.

• Room to shape both the technology and the way the team works, including our use of AI.

• Close interaction with colleagues across R&D - scientists, hardware engineers, product managers - and an informal tone where people help each other out.

• The energy of a scaleup: fast decisions, visible results, and a product portfolio that is still taking shape.

• A team that enjoys working together, celebrates releases, and takes team spirit seriously.

We are committed to an inclusive workplace and welcome applicants of all genders and backgrounds. If you are unsure whether you tick every box, please apply anyway - we would rather have the conversation.

How to apply

Apply via LinkedIn. If you have questions about the role, you are welcome to contact the hiring manager (VP R&D).

Start date: as soon as possible. We review applications on an ongoing basis and close the process once we have found the right match.

Do you have a strong eye for design, and do you enjoy turning creative ideas into tangible experiences?

In collaboration with Actief Hartmanns, Axlab is looking for a Graphic Designer & Event Coordinator who wants to play a key role in shaping and strengthening our visual identity.

This is a newly created position where you will have the opportunity to make a real impact. You will be responsible for developing visual content across digital, print, and event channels while helping bring the Axlab brand to life through trade shows, conferences, and other customer-facing activities. Essential to this role are a proven track record and interest in design execution.

You will join a dynamic Marcom team that is responsible for building Axlab into the most recognized brand for bringing innovation and automation to pathology laboratories.

The role is primarily focused on graphic design, which will account for approximately 70% of your time. The remaining 30% will involve coordinating and supporting events in close collaboration with colleagues and external partners.

The role

The Graphic Designer & Event Coordinator is responsible for leading creative direction, executing graphic design, and ensuring the quality of all visual assets across digital, print, and event media. The role will bring Axlab’s graphic design capability fully in-house for the first time, owning the brand’s visual identity, building scalable asset libraries, and co-creating with external agencies where needed. Alongside design, this person works closely with the Events & Digital Platforms Manager on delivering standout experiences at trade shows, conferences, and hosted events. This role will also spend up to 30% of the time on event coordination, so there must be an interest in working on event execution.

Your responsibilities:

Graphic Design

• Contribute to creative strategy and visual concepts.

• Apply the CVI and ensure consistent brand evolution and strategy while adapting visuals to meet campaign objectives and country differences, where needed.

• Design creative assets for campaigns, events, and country requests across digital and print channels.

• Design based on knowledge of customer segmentation, journey mapping, and value proposition frameworks.

• Work with agencies, the CMO, and the Director, Marcom to evolve the brand and marketing materials, as needed.

• Create asset libraries to support scalability and efficiency.

• Maintain updated files across our systems.

• Use relevant AI and digital design tools to improve creativity, efficiency, and workflows.

Event Coordination

• Planning & logistics: managing the end-to-end event timeline from brief to debrief, coordinating booth/space bookings, A/V, catering, and floor logistics. For trade shows specifically: managing exhibit builds, shipping, and setup/teardown.

• Vendor & supplier management: sourcing and briefing vendors (printers, fabricators, AV, promotional items), negotiating contracts, and holding suppliers accountable for timelines and budgets.

• Budget tracking: tracking spending against actuals, reconciling invoices post-event.

• Marketing & materials coordination: create and deliver event assets on time (signage, collateral, giveaways, digital screens, presentations).

• Stakeholder coordination: Work with Events & Digital Platforms Manager on aligning internal teams (sales, product, marcom) on event goals, speaker/demo needs, and who's attending from the company.

• Post-event reporting: capturing leads, attendance metrics, and ROI data; documenting lessons learned for next time.

The primary working language for this role is English, but Danish is a plus. The candidate should expect to travel up to 30% during certain periods.

What we are looking for

We are looking for a creative and proactive designer who enjoys turning ideas into clear and engaging visual communication.

• A bachelor’s degree or higher in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or another relevant design field

• 3-5 years of graphic design experience (healthcare industry or other regulated industry, or marketing agency experience preferred)

• Design Expertise: Strong understanding of composition, color, hierarchy, and design best practices, along with a portfolio showcasing diverse projects across digital and print formats.

• Technical Proficiency: Mastery of Adobe InDesign, Illustrator, and Photoshop. Experience with AI design tools is a plus.

• Brand Stewardship: Proven ability to apply and assist in the evolution of a Corporate Visual Identity, maintaining consistency across a wide range of asset types while allowing for project-level creative flexibility.

• Commercial & Business Mindset: Understanding of marketing goals, customer value propositions, and how visual design supports pipeline, brand awareness, and commercial objectives.

• Openness to Event Execution (required): Genuine interest in spending up to 30% of the time on event coordination, including hands-on execution, occasional travel, and learning new processes and tools on the job.

A role with both creativity and impact

This is an opportunity to make a visible impact. You will be the first dedicated graphic design resource in-house and will therefore have considerable influence over how we develop and manage our visual identity.

You will combine creative freedom with ownership and structure, working across various projects and collaborating with colleagues, suppliers, and agencies.

The role also offers the opportunity to develop your skills beyond traditional graphic design, particularly within event execution, project coordination, digital tools, and AI-supported creative workflows.
